data.one_liner: CLI tool that checks lcov coverage against a threshold
data.what_it_does: It reads an lcov tracefile and exits with status 0 if the coverage is at or above the given percentage, otherwise it exits with status 1 and prints the top uncovered files.
use_when: Enforcing a minimum coverage percentage in CI pipelines
Running coverage checks locally during development
avoid_when: You need to analyze coverage in formats other than lcov
You want a graphical coverage report
strengths: No build or code generation required
weaknesses: No support for other coverage formats or platforms
